name: @ijfw/memory-server
description: Cross-platform persistent memory server for IJFW. 14 MCP tools (memory + admin/update + brain). Works with 15 platforms: 14 via MCP (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Hermes, Wayland, OpenCode, QwenCode, Cline, KimiCode, OpenClaw, Antigravity) plus Aider via the rules-only tier.
author: Sean Donahoe

scripts.test: node test.js && node --experimental-sqlite --test --test-force-exit test-*.js test/brain/test-*.js test/memory/test-*.js test/integration/test-*.js test/profile-*.test.mjs src/profile/eval/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:graders: node test/grade-symbol-graph-spec.js && node test/grade-symbol-graph-consistency.js && node test/grade-cascading-staleness.js && node test/grade-project-types.js
